limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the early combinational `valid_b` but also made `ready_a` high during reset and before the first active clock edge, and gated the registered `valid_b` on `valid_a` instead of preserving the count-only decode during stalls at count 5.

The test hard-coded ready high even during reset and expected valid low on stalls before the sixth bit, so its pass confirmed the rewrite’s assumptions rather than checking the behavior the fix needed to preserve.
